basic_info.description: 1246 25th Avenue is a beautifully designed two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home with an expansive family room/guest suite on the lower level. The main floor boasts a bright, spacious living room with soaring ceilings and a cozy fireplace, a formal dining room, and a gourmet kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and an inviting eat-in peninsula. The two large bedrooms offer generous closet space, while the one-and-a-half bathrooms are elegantly appointed with timeless finishes. A central courtyard and an east-facing deck provide direct access to a professionally landscaped garden, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The lower level includes a two-car garage, a versatile guest suite/family room, and an additional bathroom. Situated just a half-block from Golden Gate Park and the vibrant restaurants and cafes of Irving Street, 1246 25th Avenue offers both convenience and an exceptional lifestyle.
